context: This criteria evaluates whether the solution correctly uses the request package's timing and timeout options to measure request performance and handle timeout scenarios.

checklist.name: time option
checklist.description: Uses the time option set to true to enable timing measurements

checklist.name: elapsedTime access
checklist.description: Accesses response.elapsedTime or request.elapsedTime to get timing data

checklist.name: timeout option
checklist.description: Uses the timeout option to set request timeout in milliseconds

checklist.name: Timeout error handling
checklist.description: Detects and handles timeout errors by checking for ETIMEDOUT or ESOCKETTIMEDOUT error codes

checklist.name: Timing statistics
checklist.description: Aggregates timing data across multiple requests for performance analysis
